title: The genitive and the locative
description: The two cases you meet most often after prepositions, with their common endings.

blocks.text: The genitive answers kogo? czego? (of whom? of what?). It follows do, od, z (from), bez (without) and u (at someone's place), negated verbs (nie mam czasu) and quantities (dużo pracy, pięć złotych). Common singular endings: feminine -y or -i (kawy, pracy), masculine -a or -u (brata, domu), neuter -a (mleka). The locative answers o kim? o czym? and follows w, na, o and przy: w domu, na poczcie, o filmie. Its endings vary more, often with a change of consonant: Kraków becomes w Krakowie, poczta becomes na poczcie.

blocks.translation: I am going to my brother's.
I am at the post office.
blocks.note: Locative after na: poczta becomes poczcie.

blocks.translation: We are talking about the film.
